LanguageData.NR_AttackBlocked: Network attack stopped ({0}): {1} caught it in time.
LanguageData.NR_AttackNeuralNoise: Someone is pushing garbage signal through the colony's cyberlinks. Affected: {0}.\n\nThe noise will fade in about a day.
LanguageData.NR_AttackPowerSurge: A forged command from the grid controller dumped the charge of {0} batteries and locked the grid down: no electricity for {1} days.
LanguageData.NR_AttackDataTheft: Someone copied and wiped part of the colony's data: {0} cyberdata and {1} advanced cyberdata are gone.
LanguageData.NR_AttackRansom: Ransomware has taken over the colony's machine controllers. The message is short: pay {0} silver, or they shut down.
LanguageData.NR_AttackRansomPaid: Paid {0} silver. The machines are back under your control.
LanguageData.NR_ThreatWarn:
Your trace just reached "{0}". Someone in the net noticed and is getting ready: expect a network attack in {1}–{2} hours.
A netrunner in a cyberpod or a Warden or Predator AI on the server can stop it; network isolation keeps it out.
